scope: Creative, productivity and scientific software expansion wave 2
methodology: Primary developer, institute, repository, license, documentation and release sources were read.
Source observations are concise factual paraphrases with retrieval hashes. Failed endpoints are retained only in retrievals, never as evidence.
Known pricing, license and platforms have claim-specific source supports; unresolved classifications remain unknown.
Recommendations express workflow fit and tradeoffs, not measured superiority. No downloaded executable was run.
Repository endpoints and product names were checked against existing source records to avoid duplicate applications.

Continuation evidence uses reviewed official web documents and GitHub connector file contents; retrieval source references or Git blob SHAs are recorded when available. Browser retrieval does not imply executable, entitlement, or link-health verification.
